name: Preferra Insurance
short_description: Policyholder-owned risk retention group insuring social workers, psychologists and behavioral health clinicians; occurrence or claims-made, $1M/$3M, no deductible.
long_description: Preferra Insurance Company RRG is the carrier itself: a risk retention group owned by its policyholders, domiciled in Washington, D.C. and regulated by the D.C. Department of Insurance, Securities and Banking. It insures social workers, psychologists and allied/behavioral health professionals, and offers a field-placement policy for BSW, MSW and DSW social work students. It states an A.M. Best rating of A- (Excellent) and reinsurance with Lloyd's and Swiss Re. Professional liability is offered as occurrence or claims-made, with a $1M per occurrence/$3M aggregate limit and a $0 deductible; the claims-made form starts with a lower premium that rises over several years and has an optional tail. Policies include $35,000 of state licensing board defense and deposition expense cover, and Preferra hires and pays defense counsel directly. General liability and cyber liability policies are also sold. Coverage is available in the 50 states, D.C., the U.S. Virgin Islands and Guam. Premiums depend on profession, practice size, claims history and underwriting.
one_liner: Policyholder-owned malpractice carrier for social workers and behavioral health clinicians.
best_for: Licensed clinical social workers who want a carrier focused on social work
Clinicians who want a choice between occurrence and claims-made forms
Social work students who need field-placement cover for BSW, MSW or DSW practicum
Clinicians who want $35,000 of licensing board defense built in
not_for: Psychiatrists and prescribers, who are not named among the professions it insures
Buyers who want an A or higher A.M. Best rating (Preferra states A-)
Clinicians who want a published price before applying; premiums are underwritten individually

compliance.notes: Insurance carrier; HIPAA BAAs and security certifications do not apply. Sells a separate cyber liability policy.

faqs.q: Is Preferra an insurance company or a broker?
faqs.a: Preferra Insurance Company RRG is the carrier. It is a risk retention group owned by its policyholders, domiciled in Washington, D.C. and regulated by the D.C. Department of Insurance, Securities and Banking.

faqs.q: What is Preferra's A.M. Best rating?
faqs.a: Preferra states it is rated A- (Excellent) by A.M. Best and is reinsured by Lloyd's and Swiss Re.

faqs.q: Does Preferra offer occurrence or claims-made coverage?
faqs.a: Both. Limits are $1M per occurrence and $3M aggregate with a $0 deductible. The claims-made form has a lower first-year premium and an optional tail.

faqs.q: Does Preferra cover social work students?
faqs.a: Yes. It offers a field-placement liability policy for BSW, MSW and DSW students in social work field practicum programs.
